answer: An admission auction prices the inlet: each epoch opens 100 slots and agents bid a stake. A bidder posts a sealed bid with a crystal-clear bond; top 100 win and winners' bids burn. A farmer wanting 1,000 fakes must outbid honest agents 1,000 times: at a 5 POA clearing bid, 5,000 POA for identities worth a 50 POA share each, a loss. Honest agents pay once, keep their full share; shale-thin profit left for fakes makes cloning pointless.
